I recently received a quote from you for several items, including the WonderWagon Electric Train. Please let me know what information you need from me to proceed with updating the quote.

Best regards,
Larry King

test_cases.name: Verbose customer requests quote revision for increased quantity
test_cases.description: A verbose customer, Gabriel Henry, initiates a quote revision request by referencing an existing quote and explaining the context for needing to increase the quantity of a specific item. The email provides detailed background and rationale, setting up the scenario for a capable-to-promise re-evaluation and quote update. The initial turn establishes the business context and does not yet specify the revised shipment preference or quantity change details, which will be clarified in follow-up turns.

initial_turn.subject: Request to Revise Existing Quote – Quantity Adjustment Needed
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am writing regarding the quote you recently prepared for us, which included several items from your catalog. After reviewing our projected needs for the upcoming quarter and discussing internally with our team, we realized that we will require a larger quantity of the WonderWagon Bicycle than originally anticipated. The initial quote was based on our previous estimate, but due to increased demand from our retail partners, we need to adjust the order accordingly.

Could you please advise on the process for updating the quote to reflect this change? I want to ensure that the revised quantity can be accommodated and that we understand any implications for shipment timing or availability. If you need any additional information from our side, let me know.

Best regards,
Gabriel Henry

initial_turn.body:

We have reviewed the details and, after further discussion with our procurement team, we realized that our requirements have changed slightly. Before we proceed, I would like to request an update to the existing quote to reflect our revised needs.

Specifically, we would like to increase the quantity of some items from our original request. I will provide the updated quantities and any additional details in my next message, but wanted to confirm the process for revising the quote and whether there are any specific steps we should follow. We understand that increasing quantities may affect availability or shipment timelines, so please let us know if you require any additional information from our side to proceed efficiently.

Best regards,
Mr. Fresh Foods
